title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Schedule G: Transition-Out Assistance and Data Return
content:
At offboarding, ClearPath Managed IT Services provides transition-out assistance hours at no charge by tier, prices further assistance at an hourly rate, and allows the client a window after closing to request an export of retained documentation and configurations.

| Tier | Transition-out assistance included at offboarding | Rate for further transition assistance (USD per hour) | Data return window after closing |
|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 0 hours | 175.00 | 30 calendar days |
| ClearPath Essentials | 4 hours | 175.00 | 30 calendar days |
| ClearPath Standard | 8 hours | 175.00 | 30 calendar days |
| ClearPath Professional | 12 hours | 165.00 | 45 calendar days |
| ClearPath Premier | 16 hours | 165.00 | 60 calendar days |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 40 hours | 160.00 | 90 calendar days |

The rate applies to transition assistance beyond the included hours. The data return window counts the calendar days after closing within which the client may request export of retained documentation and configurations.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A ClearPath Professional client needing 20 hours of transition assistance receives 12 hours at no charge; the remaining 8 hours are priced at 165.00 per hour, 1320.00 in all.
